content: Human-labeling session — def-surprise-flank-react:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, intel reports the enemy will attack from the NORTH. Terrain agrees — the north edge is a rocky band with a single narrow opening, covered by two pre-built pillboxes (stationary defensive turrets) on the lane mouth above YOUR yard. Your Construction Yard spawns either WEST (x=20) or EAST (x=40) by seed; the pre-built pillboxes follow. Four rifle defenders are distributed around the yard on hold-fire orders. Two waves of attackers arrive mid-episode. Win bar: four kills, two own units alive, no more than two own units lost, yard standing, within about fifty turns.
